Ai2's Asta Project ( https://allenai.org/asta ) aims to rapidly advance science, developing solutions in the areas of AI research assistants for scientists, literature understanding and synthesis, end-to-end discovery, human-AI interaction and intelligent interfaces, data-driven discovery, agents that can learn over time, methods for training agentic models, and the evaluation and benchmarking of agents. Part of this work is conducted within a scientific domain rather than alongside one. We collaborate directly with research scientists at the Allen Institute and elsewhere on their primary data, including electrophysiology, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomic measurements of human brain tissue. Our aim is to build agentic workflows that meet the standards of rigorous scientific work and to push the tools we already have to their full potential in support of research that is only now possible with AI. fresh_leads.title: Structural Engineer 1
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or Civil Engineering. Experience with structural / mechanical engineering analysis. Experience with a variety of metallic structural analysis methods. Ability to perform routine analyses with oversight from lead analysts. Excellent communication, writing and oral skills and the ability to work with a wide range of team members including mechanical designers, internal and external customers and subcontractors at a program level. Time management skills and strong self-initiative. Ability to assess and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and industry/government standards. Finite element modeling experience. Ability to travel.

fresh_leads.title: Structural Dynamics Engineer 1
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Basic Qualifications A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field from an accredited college or university is required. Excellent interpersonal skills, including demonstrated ability to work well in a team environment (class projects and internships considered acceptable). Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong time management skills.
